  "summary": "This two-page English telegram record, sent by Minoo Masani from the Swatantra Party's central office on 22 January 1963, communicates the party's position on the Colombo proposals and the Constitution Bill. Masani tells N. G. Ranga that he agrees with C. Rajagopalachari's letter and considers it essential for the Swatantra Party to move an amendment, jointly or separately, reaffirming the final paragraph of the party's 14 November resolution and categorically rejecting the Colombo proposals.\n\nThe second telegram states that the party's Parliamentary Board has decided that members of Parliament should abstain from participating in debate and voting on the Constitution Bill. Together, the messages advocate a firm parliamentary posture: an amendment should be pressed rather than abandoned, while the Board's decision on abstention should be respected. The document has no printed title and consists of two telegram sheets, including a confirmatory copy.",
